protocol.evaluation: Official Test50 queries (LeWM eval.py seed-42 sample), 50-step planning budget, goal 25 steps ahead. In each shift condition only the observation is shifted; the goal image is clean. Each base model is planned with its own native settings (GAWM: up to 3 history frames; SMWM: 1).
protocol.video: Replay of the actions executed in the recorded Test run inside the native simulator; no re-planning and no model inference. Panels show the model-input frame of that condition; the centre shows the goal image given to both models. A successful episode stops at its success step (official evaluation does not step it further).
protocol.fidelity: A clip is kept only if, for both models, replaying all 50 queries of that condition reproduces the recorded success vector exactly (also checked: initial-state digests and the recorded initial/final simulator state).
protocol.layout: left: base model | centre: goal (not shifted) | right: base model + LeNS-JEPA
protocol.format: H.264 yuv420p, faststart, no audio, 960x448, 10 fps, <= 12 s; 5 environment steps per second; poster = last frame

selection_rules.demo: Pre-registered, from the recorded Test50 success vectors and executed-action traces only: for each (base, task, shift in Gray, Hue, Blur, Noise, C-B), the queries where base + LeNS-JEPA succeeds and the base model fails, with base + LeNS-JEPA needing at least 8 environment steps to succeed; up to 3 in ascending Test50 index. Fewer or none if fewer such queries exist.
selection_rules.failure: Pre-registered fairness clip, one per (base, task): a query where the base model succeeds and base + LeNS-JEPA fails; the first shift in the order Gray, Hue, Blur, Noise, C-B that has such a query (and passes the replay check), then the lowest Test50 index.
selection_rules.clean: In-distribution (no shift), one per (base, task): the lowest Test50 index where both models succeed and each needs at least 10 environment steps.
selection_rules.fidelity_gate: A condition is used only if replaying the recorded executed actions of all 50 queries reproduces the recorded success vector exactly for both models; otherwise its clips are skipped.
